mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `DietRecords`( `userId`, `recordDate`, `mealKey`, `clientRecordId`, `score`, `kcal`, `carbs`, `protein`, `fat`, `fiber`, `itemsJson`, `acceptedAt`, `dayGoalKcal` ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{recordDate}, #{mealKey}, #{clientRecordId}, #{score}, #{kcal}, #{carbs}, #{protein}, #{fat}, #{fiber}, #{itemsJson}, #{acceptedAt}, #{dayGoalKcal} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `clientRecordId` = VALUES(`clientRecordId`), `score` = VALUES(`score`), `kcal` = VALUES(`kcal`), `carbs` = VALUES(`carbs`), `protein` = VALUES(`protein`), `fat` = VALUES(`fat`), `fiber` = VALUES(`fiber`), `itemsJson` = VALUES(`itemsJson`), `acceptedAt` = VALUES(`acceptedAt`), `dayGoalKcal` = VALUES(`dayGoalKcal`), `updatedAt` = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
